📺 It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia (2005–Present)

It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia follows a group of dysfunctional friends who run Paddy’s Pub, an unsuccessful Irish bar in Philadelphia. Dennis Reynolds, Dee Reynolds, Mac, Charlie Kelly, and Frank Reynolds constantly find themselves involved in ridiculous schemes, selfish competitions, and outrageous situations. Their questionable decisions and lack of self-awareness frequently turn ordinary experiences into chaotic disasters. Whether attempting to become wealthy, pursuing romantic relationships, or competing against one another, the group rarely learns from its mistakes. Starring Charlie Day, Rob McElhenney, Glenn Howerton, Kaitlin Olson, and Danny DeVito, the series combines dark humor, absurd comedy, and sharp satire while exploring friendship, selfishness, social hypocrisy, and the hilarious consequences of irresponsible behavior.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Dark Comedy • Satire • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 8.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Rob McElhenney

📍 Setting: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu (United States; availability may vary).
